examples.text: Nachdem brutalen Unfall wurde der Junge vaterlos, weil sein Vater starb. Nur er und seine Mutter lebten noch.
examples.translation: After the brutal accident the boy became fatherless, because his father died. Only he and his mother still lived.
examples.english: After the brutal accident the boy became fatherless, because his father died. Only he and his mother still lived.

examples.text: „Fast 2,5 Millionen Kinder in Deutschland haben im Zweiten Weltkrieg ihren Vater verloren. Beinahe jedes vierte Kind wuchs ohne männlichen Elternteil auf. Aber bis heute hat sich kaum jemand für das Schicksal dieser vaterlosen Kinder interessiert.“
„Sie arbeitete schwer, um ihren vaterlosen Kindern ein Heim zu schaffen.“

“Homer’s Triple Bypass” has the potential to be the most depressing episode in the history of The Simpsons, if not television as whole. It is, after all, about a 36-year-old husband and father staring down death and the prospect of leaving his wife a young widow and his small children fatherless.
